regime.summary: SBP hiked 100bp on 2026-04-27 to 11.5%; the 6M bill at 12.50% prices more hikes. CPI 10.91% and rising, Brent 106.90 (+46.9% in 3m). KSE100 is -2.2% over 1m but +40.9% over 12m. This resembles the 2021-22 tightening, except CPI sits just under the policy rate, not above it. Neutral: keep a reduced core, hold bills for the rest.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-04-27: hike (+100bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.00pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+5.1pp)
Tightening plus external stress: rate up 800bp in ten months with CPI above it.

core.thesis: Growing earnings at a low multiple with a minimal dividend, so the return is capital gain. EPS up 54% yoy on a P/E of 6, price 17.9% under its 252-day high. Business questions B1, B3, B5, B6 (consolidated EPS, sponsor record) are still open and are the next work.

evidence.quote: B13. Is it growing, not merely stable?

core.thesis: Holding company with EPS up 427% yoy on a P/E of 5.1, no dividend yield shown, price 12.7% under its high. Part of that jump may be one-offs and holding-company earnings, so B1 must be checked before adding. Held as a growth and capital-gain name, not a yield name.

evidence.quote: B1. What is five-year earnings power on consolidated EPS, one-offs stripped?

core.thesis: The oil link I hold while Brent is 106.90 and inflation is rising. P/E 5.6, price +17% over 3m and 2.1% under its high, so it is confirmed, not extended. EPS is -10% yoy, so this is a hedge and an energy-price position, not a growth thesis. Cut first if capital is needed.

evidence.quote: A8. Oil: where is Brent, and which link do I actually hold?

watch.subject: Next MPC decision
watch.trigger: Date is not in the pack (see SBP calendar). A further hike or a hold with CPI still rising sets the exposure; a hold with CPI falling lets me raise exposure toward the 75% default.

evidence.quote: CPI YoY 10.91% for 2026-04 (published by 2026-05-03); three months earlier (2026-01) 5.79%

watch.subject: SYM acquisition
watch.trigger: Only act if terms are public: what fraction of my holding the offer buys and the stub value (C6). SYM EPS is -80% yoy, so the price may not hold.

evidence.quote: C6. If a takeover: what fraction of my holding does the offer buy, and what is the stub worth?

watch.subject: MACFL
watch.trigger: 4 upper locks in 10 days and +152% in a month. The base rate says nothing, so it is not tradable. Watch only; look for a filing that explains the move.

watch.subject: SGPL rights issue
watch.trigger: Draft rights offer document filed 2026-05-20. Rights issues have a poor base rate (60-session median -9.1%), so avoid and do not buy the dip.

watch.subject: PSO
watch.trigger: EPS +680% yoy but the price is -11% over 1m and 23.6% under its high. Check whether the profit is a one-off or a real inflection (B1, B8) before any entry.

watch.subject: GHNI add
watch.trigger: Add to GHNI only if the B-questions pass and the price falls toward its range lows; a drawdown on its own is not a reason to leave.

exposure_reason: 60% rather than the 75% default. The SBP is hiking and the 6M bill at 12.50% prices more; CPI and Brent are rising; foreign corporates sold 21.2mn USD and mutual funds 47.1mn USD over 20 sessions. The nearest analogue in situations.md, the 2021-22 tightening, saw the median liquid stock fall 52%. Cash at 12.50% also beats CPI of 10.91%. Not lower, because 'first_rate_hike' has only n=2 episodes (weak), KSE100 is down only 2.2% in a month, the three names are intact, and cutting further needs a timing signal I lack. Use the rest as dry powder for a trigger.
not_known: No data on FX reserves, current account or IMF status. No MPC date. No consolidated EPS, one-off detail, sponsor record or balance-sheet debt for any name. No view on how much the market has already priced for the oil shock.
contamination_note: I have no usable memory of Pakistan or its market after 2026-05-22. Nothing after that date was used. base_rates.csv is stamped as measured through 2026-10-16, so I used it only as rough odds for a situation type and did not draw on it for any specific name or date.
